## About
S S Performance Automotive is a repair shop on Progress Road in South Miami. The owner, Jose Gil, is a Master ASE certified technician and a Corvette specialist, and he works alongside Gary and the rest of the crew.
Customers bring in everything from newer Corvettes to vintage Vettes and classic muscle cars. Reviewers keep mentioning the same things: honest answers, good communication and fair prices. That's how the shop has earned a 4.6 rating from 55 Google reviews.

## Services
- Corvette service: From warning lights and oil leaks to older Vettes that won't run right, this is the shop's specialty.
- Classic muscle cars: The crew works on classic muscle cars and more, not just Corvettes.
- Engine and carb maintenance: Routine engine and carb work for older cars, done quickly.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Corvettes?
A: Corvettes are the specialty, but the shop also works on classic muscle cars and other cars.

Q: Will you tell me the cost before doing the work?
A: Reviewers say Jose calls after drop-off to go over what the car needs and what the pricing would be.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The shop is closed Saturday and Sunday.
